# 9jawap Icons

Webfont kit for the official 9jawap brand icon.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/9jawap/9jawap-icons@v1.0.0/dist/9jawap-icons.min.css">
<i class="jw jw-9jawap" aria-hidden="true"></i>
```

Replace `OWNER` with the GitHub account owner after publishing.
